lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, you're speaking with Marcus from Retailer One. Before we go any further I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue on a recorded line?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yeah, that's fine, go ahead.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. Can I just confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, Oliver Grant, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, that's me. Oliver Grant, the account's in my name.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Perfect, thanks Oliver. And the supply address is 8 Park Lane, Brighton, Victoria, three one eight six?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That's the one.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. So this is about the Saver Flex plan. Before any numbers there's a short statement I'm required to read to you in full.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No worries.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The Default Market Offer is the reference price set by the Australian Energy Regulator. The estimated annual cost of this plan is four per cent less than the reference price for an average household in your distribution zone. This is an estimate only, and your actual cost will depend on your usage.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, got it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: A couple of quick questions first. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment, and do you hold a concession card?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No to both.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Let me pull the pricing up for you.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: On the Saver Flex plan your usage rate is 31.9 cents per kilowatt hour including GST, and the daily supply charge is ninety-eight point four five cents a day.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That sounds reasonable.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The rate isn't locked, we'd give you written notice before any change and you could leave then with no exit fee. Are you happy for me to go ahead?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, let's do it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: What's the best email for your welcome pack and contract? The cooling-off notice goes there too.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: It's oliver dot grant at gmail dot com.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Lovely, got it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And just to confirm the NMI off your bill, I've got 6 1 0 2 8 8 1 1 4 4 5. Does that match?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, that matches.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And this is electricity only, you're not bringing gas across?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Electricity only.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That's everything. You'll get the welcome pack by email within one business day and your ten business day cooling-off period starts when it lands.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks Marcus, bye.
